units.source_text: 这配给油是专为住持作古准备的，足够用了，所以火焰反而逆着雨点发出鞭答似的声音，而且越来越大。

en.t: This rationed oil had been prepared especially for the abbot's death rites, and there was more than enough of it, so the flames instead beat back against the raindrops with a whip-cracking sound and grew ever larger.

units.source_text: 在浓烟之中，白昼的火焰现出了透明的体态，清晰可见。

en.t: Amid the dense smoke, the daytime flames revealed a transparent form, clearly visible.

units.source_text: 浓烟滚滚，渐渐刮到了山崖那边，一瞬间里，惟有火焰在雨中以端丽的形状缭绕上升。

en.t: The thick smoke billowed and was gradually blown toward the far side of the cliff; for one instant, only the flames rose winding through the rain in a graceful shape.
